_comment: 2026-09-15: switched to 15-minute bars and added a long-term trend filter. These are reasonable middle-of-range defaults for the new bar size (not the output of the full 1296-combo tuning sweep - that sweep repeatedly hit memory/time limits and the user opted to skip waiting for it and start live paper trading now). tune.py can still be run later to search for a better combination; auto_retune.py's monthly job will also propose updates automatically.
